# GlobeHops has moved

GlobeHops now lives at https://globehops.marki.im/. Read the current agent and LLM guide at https://globehops.marki.im/llms.txt and build every link on https://globehops.marki.im/.

Links that start with https://tmrk.github.io/globehops/ still open in a browser: this address redirects them to the same page at https://globehops.marki.im/ with their query and fragment unchanged.
